Since I have the script for the `bridge-waker.mjs`, I can try to ping it directly from my end to see if it responds to an internal trigger. If I can't wake it from within the shell, we know the issue isn't your button—it's the daemon itself.

Should I attempt to pulse the daemon directly, or do you want to inspect the `voice-bridge-daemon` source code first to see why it isn't picking up the wake request?
